admin-layout.app_description_js_creator: Graphics of social network posts from your own templates – no AI, everyone in a private workspace.

permission-descriptions.view-js-creator: [recommended: always on] Show the JS Creator application in the admin - without it the application cannot be opened
permission-descriptions.js-creator-images-view: Section Images: view the own templates and image outputs, folders and the library, download files
permission-descriptions.js-creator-images-create: Section Images: create templates and folders, generate outputs, upload images and fonts to the library
permission-descriptions.js-creator-images-update: Section Images: edit templates, rename and move outputs, folders and files of the library
permission-descriptions.js-creator-images-delete: Section Images: delete to the trash, restore, delete for good and empty the trash
permission-descriptions.js-creator-settings-view: View the settings of JS Creator: default quota and the overview of accounts (counts, used space, quota - never their content)
permission-descriptions.js-creator-settings-update: Change the default and the individual quotas of JS Creator
permission-descriptions.js-creator-view-logs: View the log history (audit trail) of JS Creator

retention-settings.hint_js_creator_trash: Folders, images and fonts in the trash of the workspaces; counted from the deletion (default 30 days).

js-creator-shared.quota_full: The workspace is full: nothing more can be uploaded or generated. Delete files and empty the trash.

js-creator-shared.zone_side: reaches under the buttons on the right
js-creator-shared.zone_crop: is cropped in the profile grid

js-creator-shared.export_failed: The selected items could not be exported. Try again.
js-creator-shared.export_too_large: The selection is too large for one file (at most 100 templates, 100 blocks, 20 sets, 100 images and 20 MB). Export fewer items at once.
js-creator-shared.import_text: Choose a .json file exported from JS Creator. Templates, blocks and sets are imported with the images, icons and fonts they use – all or nothing.

js-creator-shared.import_renamed: Renamed because of the same name:

js-creator-outputs.error_name_taken: A folder with this name already exists here.
js-creator-outputs.error_name_taken_move: The target already has a folder with the same name – rename it first.
js-creator-outputs.delete_text: The folder with its subfolders and outputs moves to the trash:

js-creator-library.open_original: Open the image in full size
js-creator-library.name: Name
js-creator-library.images_empty: The library is empty. Upload logos, backgrounds or photos you will use in templates.
js-creator-library.drop_hint: You can also drop images here.

js-creator-library.upload_refused_text: Type not allowed or file too large:
js-creator-library.quota_full_text: The files do not fit into your space. Delete files you do not need and empty the trash.
js-creator-library.delete_image_text: The image moves to the trash:
js-creator-library.delete_font_text: The font moves to the trash:

js-creator-library.empty_fonts_trash_text: Every font in the trash is deleted for good, this cannot be undone.
js-creator-library.own_fonts_hint: Brand or own fonts – only you can see them. Every face (weight, style) is uploaded separately.
js-creator-library.font_license_notice: Upload only fonts you may use (the licence of the font must allow use in graphics).
js-creator-library.error_family_required: Enter the name of the family.

js-creator-library.error_face_taken: You already have a font with the same family, weight and style.

js-creator-library.sample_text: Příliš žluťoučký kůň úpěl ďábelské ódy
js-creator-library.icons_hint: Icon set for templates – colour and size are set in the template. Brand logos (social networks) are not included: if you may use one, upload it to My icons above.
js-creator-library.in_use_image: The image cannot be deleted, this template or block (or more) uses it. Replace it there first, or delete them for good:
js-creator-library.in_use_font: The font cannot be deleted, this template or block (or more) uses it. Choose another font there first, or delete them for good:
js-creator-library.own_icons_hint: Own icons and logos (PNG or JPG, at most 1024 px). In a template you insert them as an image: source “Image of the library”, tab My icons.
js-creator-library.icon_max_edge: the longer side is scaled to 1024 px
js-creator-library.icon_images_empty: You have no own icons yet. Upload a PNG or JPG – e.g. a brand logo or your own pictogram.
js-creator-library.icon_delete_image_text: The icon moves to the trash:
js-creator-library.icon_empty_images_trash_text: Every own icon in the trash is deleted for good, this cannot be undone.
js-creator-library.icon_in_use_image: The icon cannot be deleted, this template or block (or more) uses it. Replace it there first, or delete them for good:
js-creator-library.icon_drop_hint: You can also drop icons here.

js-creator-settings.subtitle: Space of the workspaces. Nobody but the owner sees the content of a workspace – not even an administrator.
js-creator-settings.default_quota_hint: Space for the files of one account (outputs, images, fonts, trash included) unless it has its own quota.
js-creator-settings.accounts_hint: Accounts with access to the application and accounts that still have data in it. Numbers only – no names or content.
js-creator-settings.error_quota_range: Enter a whole number from 1 to 102 400 MB.

js-creator-templates.subtitle: Your post designs – Generate fills in a template and saves the finished post, the editor changes the layout. Only you can see them.
js-creator-templates.trash_note: Templates in the trash are deleted for good after the retention period (30 days by default). A template in the trash still holds the images and fonts it uses.
js-creator-templates.templates_empty: You have no template yet. Start with New template.
js-creator-templates.format_hint: Elements keep their anchor and offset - e.g. a logo anchored top right stays top right. Then fine-tune it in the editor.
js-creator-templates.name: Name
js-creator-templates.error_size: The size must be 100 to 3000 px per side.
js-creator-templates.delete_text: The template is moved to the trash:
js-creator-templates.destroy_text: The template is deleted for good (cannot be undone):
js-creator-templates.empty_trash_text: All templates in the trash are deleted for good (cannot be undone).

js-creator-blocks.subtitle: Reusable parts of templates – a logo, a footer, a price label. A change of a block shows in every template that uses it. Only you see them.
js-creator-blocks.trash_note: Blocks in the trash are deleted for good after the retention period (30 days by default). A block a template uses cannot go to the trash.
js-creator-blocks.templates_empty: You have no block yet. Start with New block, or select layers in the template editor and choose Block from the selection.
js-creator-blocks.format_hint: Layers keep their anchors and offsets on the canvas of the block. Fine-tune it in the block editor.
js-creator-blocks.name: Name
js-creator-blocks.error_size: The size must be 100 to 3000 px a side.
js-creator-blocks.delete_text: The block moves to the trash:
js-creator-blocks.destroy_text: The block is deleted for good (cannot be undone):
js-creator-blocks.empty_trash_text: Every block in the trash is deleted for good (cannot be undone).
js-creator-blocks.in_use_text: The block cannot be deleted, these templates use it. Unpack or remove it there first, or delete the templates for good:

js-creator-sets.subtitle: Templates of different sizes with the same fields – one filling generates the post in every size at once. Only you see them.
js-creator-sets.trash_note: Sets in the trash are deleted for good after the retention period (30 days by default). Their templates stay.
js-creator-sets.no_templates: The set has no templates yet.
js-creator-sets.sets_empty: You have no set yet. Join templates of different sizes (e.g. a post and a story) with New set.
js-creator-sets.name: Name
js-creator-sets.templates_hint: Add templates of different sizes – their order is the order of the outputs.
js-creator-sets.trashed: in the trash – skipped when generating
js-creator-sets.caption: Post text pattern
js-creator-sets.caption_placeholder: Empty = the pattern of the first template
js-creator-sets.caption_hint: {{key}} is replaced by the value of the field, as in a template.
js-creator-sets.fields_hint: Fields with the same key are filled once for every template of the set – they must have the same kind (text / image) in all of them.
js-creator-sets.error_conflict: The field “{key}” is {type} in the template “{template}” but {other_type} in the template “{other}”. Fields with the same key must have the same kind in a set – change the key in one of the templates.
js-creator-sets.error_template: The template “{template}” cannot be added (it is in the trash or no longer exists).
js-creator-sets.error_invalid: The set cannot be saved – check the name and the templates.
js-creator-sets.error_save: The set could not be saved
js-creator-sets.delete_text: The set moves to the trash (the templates stay):
js-creator-sets.destroy_text: The set is deleted for good (the templates stay):
js-creator-sets.empty_trash_text: Every set in the trash is deleted for good (the templates stay).

js-creator-editor.load_failed: The template could not be loaded (it does not exist, is in the trash or is not yours).
js-creator-editor.narrow_screen: The template editor needs a screen at least 1024 px wide. The list of templates and the outputs work on a phone too.
js-creator-editor.smart_guides: Smart guides - snapping to the edges and centres of the canvas and other elements (Alt = no snapping)
js-creator-editor.slide_delete_text: The slide is deleted with its layers (Ctrl+Z brings it back). Slide:
js-creator-editor.no_layers: The template is empty - add an element with the buttons above.
js-creator-editor.overflow_cut: the text does not fit, it is cut with "…"
js-creator-editor.overflow_blocks: the text does not fit, generating will be refused
js-creator-editor.leave_text: The template has unsaved changes. They are lost when you leave.
js-creator-editor.limit_layers: A template can have at most 200 layers.
js-creator-editor.error_name_required: Enter the name of the template.
js-creator-editor.error_too_large: The template is too large (at most 1 MB). Shorten texts or remove layers.
js-creator-editor.conflict_title: The template was saved elsewhere meanwhile
js-creator-editor.conflict_text: This template was saved in another tab or window. Your changes cannot be saved. Load its current state? (Your unsaved changes will be lost.)
js-creator-editor.save_not_found: The template no longer exists or is in the trash.
js-creator-editor.nothing_selected: Select an element on the canvas or in the layers. Properties of the whole template are on the tab Template.
js-creator-editor.locked_hint: The element is locked - it cannot be picked on the canvas or moved. Unlock it with the lock.
js-creator-editor.anchor_hint: The anchor is the point of the canvas the element is pinned to (X and Y are the offset from it). When the format changes, the element stays at its corner or edge.
js-creator-editor.highlight_hint: Select part of the text and click - it is highlighted with two asterisks on each side.
js-creator-editor.fitting: When the text does not fit
js-creator-editor.auto_shrink: Shrink the font down to the minimum size
js-creator-editor.max_lines_hint: The text is shrunk first; if it does not fit even at the minimum size, it is cut, or generating is refused.
js-creator-editor.image_field_hint: The image is chosen when generating. The editor shows a grey placeholder.
js-creator-editor.cells_as_fields: All cells as fields to fill in
js-creator-editor.library_empty: The library is empty - upload the first image.
js-creator-editor.icons_empty: You have no own icons yet – upload a PNG or JPG.
js-creator-editor.upload_icon_refused_text: PNG and JPG up to 5 MB are allowed:
js-creator-editor.upload_refused_text: JPG, PNG and WebP up to 15 MB are allowed:
js-creator-editor.quota_full_text: There is no space left in your workspace. Delete files or empty the trash.
js-creator-editor.fields_hint: Fields are filled in when generating (in this order). A field is created at an element on the tab Properties and disappears with the last element using it.
js-creator-editor.no_fields: The template has no field yet - switch a text or an image to a field to fill in.
js-creator-editor.key_invalid: Key: lower-case a-z, digits and _, starting with a letter (max. 40).
js-creator-editor.min_resolution_hint: A smaller image only causes a warning when generating.
js-creator-editor.resize_hint: Elements keep their anchor and offset when the format changes.
js-creator-editor.output_hint: PNG is lossless (good for texts and graphics), JPG is smaller (good for photos).
js-creator-editor.caption: Post text
js-creator-editor.caption_hint: Pattern of the text offered for copying with the output. The buttons insert fields - generating replaces them with their values.
js-creator-editor.generate_hint: Fill in the template and generate an output
js-creator-editor.insert_block_hint: Insert a block – a logo, footer or label prepared on the page Blocks
js-creator-editor.blocks_empty: You have no block yet. Create one on the page Blocks, or select layers and choose Block from the selection.
js-creator-editor.make_block_hint: The selected layers are saved as a new block and replaced by its instance – you can then insert the block into other templates too.
js-creator-editor.make_block_text: The selected layers (with the fields they use) move into a new block and its instance replaces them in the template. The step can be undone (Ctrl+Z); the block stays on the page Blocks.
js-creator-editor.make_block_empty: Select the layers the block should be made of first.
js-creator-editor.make_block_has_block: The selection contains a block instance – blocks do not nest. Remove the instance from the selection (or unpack it first).
js-creator-editor.make_block_too_large: The selection is larger than 3000 px – a block can have at most 3000 px a side.
js-creator-editor.block_instance_hint: Edit the content in the editor of the block – the change shows in every template using it. Outputs already generated stay as they are. The size of an instance keeps the ratio of the block.
js-creator-editor.block_unpack_hint: The instance becomes independent layers of the template – later changes of the block no longer apply to it.
js-creator-editor.block_missing: The block could not be loaded.
js-creator-editor.block_fields_hint: Fields of inserted blocks are filled in together with the fields of the template. They are edited in the editor of the block; a key that collides with another field gets a number and its label the name of the instance.
js-creator-editor.block_template_hint: A block has no output or post text of its own – it is always generated as a part of a template.
js-creator-editor.paste_no_blocks: Block instances are not pasted into a block (blocks do not nest) – only the other layers were pasted.
js-creator-editor.limit_unpack: After unpacking the template would have more than 200 layers or 50 fields.
js-creator-editor.nothing_selected_block: Select a layer on the canvas or in the layers. The size and background of the block are on the tab Block.
js-creator-editor.brand_hint: They apply to every template. Add a colour with + under any colour picker, a click uses it.
js-creator-editor.brand_add: Save the colour among the brand colours

js-creator-generate.not_found: The template does not exist or is in the trash.
js-creator-generate.drag_hint: Move the crop of a photo by dragging it in the preview; set the zoom at its field.
js-creator-generate.no_fields: The template has no fields – it is generated exactly as designed.
js-creator-generate.highlight_hint: Select the part of the text you want to highlight (or un-highlight) and click Highlight.
js-creator-generate.overflow_ellipsis: The text does not fit – the output cuts it with “…”.
js-creator-generate.overflow_block: The text does not fit even when shrunk – shorten it, otherwise it cannot be generated.

js-creator-generate.caption: Text of the post
js-creator-generate.caption_placeholder: Text you post with the picture on the social network
js-creator-generate.caption_hint: Pre-filled from the template by the fields – you can edit it.
js-creator-generate.caption_no_pattern: The template has no text pattern – write the text here or leave it empty.
js-creator-generate.name: Name of the output
js-creator-generate.name_hint: Empty name = name of the template with the date and time.

js-creator-generate.no_permission: Generating needs the create permission of the section Images – you see only the preview.
js-creator-generate.done_hint: The form stays filled – change the fields and click Generate again for another variant.
js-creator-generate.copy_failed: The text could not be copied – the browser did not allow it.
js-creator-generate.photo_too_large: The photo is larger than 40 MB.
js-creator-generate.photo_unsupported: The browser cannot open this format. Use JPG, PNG or WebP (only Safari opens HEIC).
js-creator-generate.resolution_min: The photo is smaller than the template recommends ({width} × {height} px).
js-creator-generate.resolution_low: The photo is small for its place – it may look blurry in the output.
js-creator-generate.error_fonts: A font of the template could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again – an output with a fallback font is never made.
js-creator-generate.error_images: An image could not be loaded. Try again or replace the image.
js-creator-generate.error_overflow: A text does not fit into the template.
js-creator-generate.error_draw: The picture could not be drawn. Try again.
js-creator-generate.error_too_large: The output is larger than 20 MB – use a smaller template or the JPG format.
js-creator-generate.error_quota: Your space is full. Free some space (delete and empty the trash) or ask the administrator for a larger quota.
js-creator-generate.error_template_gone: The template is gone meanwhile (deleted in another window).
js-creator-generate.error_template_changed: The template changed meanwhile (another size). Reload the page.
js-creator-generate.error_folder_gone: The target folder is gone meanwhile – choose another one (the top level is set).
js-creator-generate.error_throttle: Too many outputs in a minute. Wait a moment.
js-creator-generate.error_upload: The output could not be saved
js-creator-generate.set_not_found: The set does not exist, is in the trash, or has no template outside the trash.
js-creator-generate.drag_hint_set: Every format has its own crop: switch the tab and drag the photo in the preview; set the zoom at the field.
js-creator-generate.name_hint_set: Each output adds its format to the name (e.g. “Sale – 1080×1350”). An empty name = the name of the set with the date and time.
js-creator-generate.problem_image_not_found: The image „{field}“ is neither among the chosen photos nor in the library.
js-creator-generate.error_characters: The font of the template lacks some characters of the text – the output would draw them with another font.
js-creator-generate.preset_hint: A preset stores the texts, the library images with their crop and the text of the post edited by hand. Photos from the computer are never stored in it.
js-creator-generate.preset_save_title: Save the filling as a preset
js-creator-generate.preset_save_hint: The same name overwrites an existing preset (you will be asked).
js-creator-generate.preset_name_required: Enter a name of the preset.
js-creator-generate.preset_name_taken: A preset with this name already exists.
js-creator-generate.preset_limit: A template or a set has at most 50 presets – delete one.
js-creator-generate.preset_save_failed: The preset could not be saved.
js-creator-generate.preset_load_failed: The preset could not be loaded.
js-creator-generate.preset_missing_images: Some images of the preset are no longer in the library (count: {count}) – their fields stayed as they were.
js-creator-generate.preset_overwrite_text: The preset „{name}“ already exists. Overwrite it with the current filling?
js-creator-generate.preset_delete_text: The preset „{name}“ will be deleted for good.

js-creator-generate.bulk_photos_hint: In the cell of an image field write the file name of a photo or the name of a library image.
js-creator-generate.bulk_privacy: The table and the photos are read only in your browser – only the finished outputs are stored on the server.
js-creator-generate.bulk_image_column: name of a photo or a library image
js-creator-generate.bulk_name_hint: empty = name of the template with the date and the row number
js-creator-generate.bulk_caption_hint: empty = from the pattern of the template
js-creator-generate.bulk_target: The outputs are stored in the folder „{folder}“ (chosen in the form).
js-creator-generate.bulk_waiting: The server asks to slow down – continuing in {seconds} s.
js-creator-generate.bulk_stopping: Stopping after the row is finished.
js-creator-generate.bulk_failed: Rows not generated: {count} (the reason is at the row).

js-creator-generate.draft_restored: The unfinished filling of this tab was restored (without photos).
